title: Sula language
description: Austronesian language spoken in North Maluku, Indonesia
extract: Sula (Sanana) is a Malayo-Polynesian language of the Central Maluku branch. It is related to the Buru language. Sula is spoken mainly on the Sulabesi, with the Sanana as its center.
